description:
Trading Decision per asset from our own live Hyperliquid engines.

    Args:
        asset: btc | eth | hype | sol | uni | zec | pine_btc

    Returns an ACO verdict: ENTER_LONG / ENTER_SHORT / WAIT + entry reference
    + exit plan (target/stop) + live track record. Paper execution — engine
    decisions are real, PnL is paper with modeled fees, not investment advice.
name: get_trading_decision
